description: The plot illustrates the relationship between training steps and a value labeled ‘BPC’. The x-axis is labeled “Training Steps” and spans from 0 to 50,000 with a linear scale and tick labels presented in intervals of 10,000. The y-axis is labeled “BPC” and ranges from 1.15 to 2.25 with a linear scale and tick labels in intervals of 0.25. A yellow line, labeled “XMoE Validating”, begins at approximately (0, 2.10), decreases to approximately (20,000, 1.27) and then fluctuates between approximately 1.23 and 1.31 until (50,000, 1.28), and is a solid line with circular markers. A purple line, labeled “SimSMoE Validating”, starts at approximately (0, 2.24), decreases to approximately (20,000, 1.25) and then fluctuates between approximately 1.23 and 1.30 until (50,000, 1.27), and is a solid line with circular markers.
